gadgets.name: Vampire
gadgets.effect: Choose one option: you recover an amount of HP equal to half the HP loss suffered by the target of the attack; or you recover an amount of MP equal to half the HP loss suffered by the target of the attack. This infusion can only be used if the attack targeted a single creature.

gadgets.name: Magitech Override (Basic)
gadgets.summary: Turn a mindless construct or elemental enemy into an ally.
gadgets.description: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 Mind Points to choose a construct or elemental enemy you can see that does not possess independent intelligence and is suffering from one or more status effects. If you do so, that enemy recovers from all status effects, then the Game Master reveals its entire profile and you may force it to immediately perform an action of your choice; during that action, the creature is treated as an ally of your group.

gadgets.name: Magicannon (Advanced)
gadgets.summary: Create and equip a magicannon that deals a chosen type of damage.
gadgets.description: You may perform the Inventory action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a magicannon (see below) and destroy any magicannon you previously created. If you do so and both your hand slots are empty, you may immediately equip the newly created magicannon and perform a free attack with it. Whenever you create a magicannon, choose what type of damage it deals among air, bolt, earth, fire, ice, or physical. WEAPON: Magicannon | ACCURACY: (DEX + INS) +1 | DAMAGE: (HR + 10) Firearm • Two-handed • Ranged • Cannot have Qualities.

gadgets.name: Magispheres (Superior)
gadgets.summary: Develop magispheres for Elementalist, Entropoist or Spiritist spells.
gadgets.description: You develop a magisphere for each of three spells from among those found in the Elementalist, Entropist, and Spiritist lists; these spells may come from the same list or from different lists (this does not count as “learning” or “knowing” these spells). You develop a new magisphere upon reaching level 20, and another upon reaching level 40 (the same applies if you already reached those levels). You may perform the Inventory action and spend 2 Inventory Points to perform the Spell action for free, casting one of the spells you have developed a magisphere for. The spell follows the normal rules (including MP costs and Magic Checks).
